item.title: Install the Camel CLI Launcher
item.description: The Camel CLI Launcher can be installed on a single machine without a package manager. The installer scripts published on this site download the launcher from Maven Central and verify it against a SHA-256 checksum published here before running it. Installation is always per-user and never requires sudo or elevation. Requirements A Java runtime discoverable on your system: Java 21 or newer for Camel 4.24 onwards, Java 17 or newer for older versions such as 4.
